description: Defines data structures and enums related to UE context management in F1AP protocol, including setup, modification, and failure parameters for SRB and DRB, as well as notification control.

classes.name: f1ap_srb_to_setup
classes.description: Parameters for setting up a Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) in the UE context.

classes.name: f1ap_srb_failed_to_setup
classes.description: Parameters indicating failure to set up an SRB, including reason.

classes.name: flow_mapped_to_drb
classes.description: Associates a QoS flow with a DRB.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_info
classes.description: Contains QoS and NSSAI info for a DRB, including notification control.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_to_setup
classes.description: Parameters for establishing a new DRB.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_to_modify
classes.description: Parameters for modifying an existing DRB.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_setupmod
classes.description: Parameters for setup or modification of a DRB, including RLC reestablishment.

classes.name: f1ap_drb_failed_to_setupmod
classes.description: Parameters indicating failure to setup or modify a DRB, including reason.
